# api.mikeodnis.dev

> Shared multi-service API gateway powering the *.mikeodnis.dev ecosystem: ElysiaJS + Bun Core Auth/Users API, Go Chi Media/R2 Upload API, Hasura GraphQL Engine, and Health Aggregator behind Caddy on Railway.

## Documentation & Discovery

- [API Console & Reference](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/): Human-readable Live Console overview, live health telemetry, rate limits, and working curl examples.
- [Unified Interactive OpenAPI Docs](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/docs): Multi-spec Scalar UI covering both Core API and Media API.
- [Core API Interactive Docs](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/core/docs): Scalar reference for `/v1/core/*`.
- [Core OpenAPI 3.1 JSON](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/core/openapi.json): Machine-readable Core API schema.
- [Media OpenAPI 3.0 JSON](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/media/openapi.json): Machine-readable Media API schema.
- [Full LLM Technical Reference](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete endpoints, authentication flows, rate-limit tiers, and working examples.
- [Security Contact](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 vulnerability reporting.

## Services

- **Core Service (`/v1/core`)**: ElysiaJS + Bun — registration, login, rotating refresh tokens, HS256 JWTs with Hasura claims, scoped `mk_live_*` API keys, user profiles, and runtime metrics (`/v1/core/status`).
- **Media Service (`/v1/media`)**: Go Chi — direct multipart uploads (up to 100 MiB) to Cloudflare R2, presigned direct-to-R2 PUT URLs, HMAC-SHA256 private CDN URL signing, asset listing/deletion, and Cloudflare edge cache purging.
- **Links GraphQL (`/v1/links/graphql`)**: Hasura GraphQL Engine serving `links.mikeodnis.dev` short-link storage and analytics.
- **Health Aggregator (`/health`)**: Unified liveness and dependency health across all platform services.
